import numpy as np

def assign_normals(xyzs):
    '''Assign normal vectors on the given atoms
    
    Args:
        xyzs (np.array): Shape (natoms, 3)
    
    Returns:
        normals (np.array): Shape (natoms, 3) - normalized normal vectors
    '''
    natoms = xyzs.shape[0]
    
    # Compute all pairwise distances
    # For each atom, find its 3 nearest neighbors
    distances = np.zeros((natoms, natoms))
    for i in range(natoms):
        for j in range(natoms):
            if i != j:
                d = np.linalg.norm(xyzs[i] - xyzs[j])
                distances[i, j] = d
    
    # Find 3 nearest neighbors for each atom
    neighbors = np.zeros((natoms, 3, 3))  # (natoms, 3 neighbors, 3 coords)
    for i in range(natoms):
        # Get indices sorted by distance (excluding self)
        dists = distances[i].copy()
        dists[i] = np.inf  # Exclude self
        neighbor_indices = np.argsort(dists)[:3]
        
        for n_idx, j in enumerate(neighbor_indices):
            neighbors[i, n_idx] = xyzs[j] - xyzs[i]
    
    # For each atom, compute 3 normalized cross products
    # Cross products of consecutive pairs of neighbor vectors
    normals = np.zeros((natoms, 3))
    
    for i in range(natoms):
        v1 = neighbors[i, 0]
        v2 = neighbors[i, 1]
        v3 = neighbors[i, 2]
        
        # Normalize the neighbor vectors
        v1_norm = v1 / np.linalg.norm(v1)
        v2_norm = v2 / np.linalg.norm(v2)
        v3_norm = v3 / np.linalg.norm(v3)
        
        # Compute 3 cross products of consecutive pairs
        # Using v1 x v2, v2 x v3, v3 x v1
        cross1 = np.cross(v1_norm, v2_norm)
        cross2 = np.cross(v2_norm, v3_norm)
        cross3 = np.cross(v3_norm, v1_norm)
        
        # Average the cross products
        avg_cross = (cross1 + cross2 + cross3) / 3.0
        
        # Normalize the average
        normed_cross_avg = avg_cross / np.linalg.norm(avg_cross)
        
        # Ensure correct direction: negative z for z > 0, positive z for z < 0
        if xyzs[i, 2] > 0:
            normed_cross_avg = -normed_cross_avg
        elif xyzs[i, 2] < 0:
            normed_cross_avg = normed_cross_avg
        
        normals[i] = normed_cross_avg
    
    return normals
